# network address value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:networkAddressValue`](gmeow-networkAddressValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/networkAddressValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The literal string value of a network address (e.g. '192.0.2.1', '00:1B:44:11:3A:B7', 'example.com', '443'). Functional: an address has exactly one value string.

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the literal string of a network address — the single functional value of an IP, MAC, DNS name, URL, or port.

### Avoid when

- Avoid putting several distinct addresses on one [`NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) (it is functional); mint a [`NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) per address.

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:networkAddressValue`](gmeow-networkAddressValue.md) per [`NetworkAddress`](../classes/gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) and pair it with [`gmeow:networkAddressType`](gmeow-networkAddressType.md).

### Examples

- ex:siteAddr [`gmeow:networkAddressValue`](gmeow-networkAddressValue.md) "192.0.2.1".
